encoder.frozen_or_finetuned: FROZEN. model.eval(), no gradient, no LoRA, no unfrozen blocks. The only trained parameters in the delivered configuration are the PCA basis and one logistic regression per field.
encoder.trainable_parameter_count_in_delivery: PCA(64) basis + LogisticRegression on 64 dims = 65 trainable numbers per field (64 coefficients + 1 intercept), plus the unsupervised PCA/scaler fit

preprocessing.pos_embed: bicubically resampled from the 37x37 pretrain grid
preprocessing.augmentation: NONE. No flip, no rotation, no colour jitter, no crop jitter. Features are extracted once per image and reused.

input_unit.what_the_model_sees: ONE STILL IMAGE at a time
input_unit.training_rows: image rows; the exam-level label is broadcast to every image of that exam
input_unit.inference_aggregation: mean of the 5 pooling probabilities, then mean over a case's images -> one probability per case
input_unit.video_frames: NOT USED. 242 videos exist and are unused by the delivered configuration.
input_unit.patient_level_aggregation: IMPOSSIBLE -- patient_id is null for all rows; aggregation is at exam level

poolings.what_they_are: statistics over the 37x49 patch tokens of a frozen encoder, plus the CLS token. They are not learned detectors and imply no lesion localisation.

estimator.loss: L2-regularised logistic loss (sklearn default lbfgs), one BINARY problem per field
estimator.class_weights: NONE. class_weight=None deliberately -- balanced weights were tested and refuted (nailfold-perfield-selection-refuted)
estimator.sampling: NONE. No oversampling, no undersampling, no focal loss in the delivered configuration.
estimator.multi_task_loss_weighting: NOT APPLICABLE -- there is no multi-task model. Each field is an independent logistic regression on the same frozen features. No shared head, no shared trunk beyond the frozen encoder, no loss balancing.
estimator.one_head_per_field: Each field has its own independent estimator. They share the features, nothing else.
estimator.per_field_selection: NONE -- one fixed configuration for all fields. Per-field selection was tested and shown to be negative-value (nailfold-perfield-selection-refuted).

missing_controls: control 2 (conventional supervised CNN/ViT baseline) is MISSING unless --resnet-store was supplied. Without it I cannot say whether DINOv2 beats an ordinary ImageNet backbone on this data.
limitations: every number here is DEVELOPMENT OOF and must never be reported as product capability
the human-measurable-feature control uses grey mean/std only, which is a weak stand-in for a clinical hand-crafted feature set; it bounds the trivial-signal floor and no more
the overfit test trains and tests on the same 20 cases on purpose; the number is diagnostic only and is not a performance claim
the reference row recomputes the delivered development OOF; small differences from the frozen numbers would indicate a reimplementation drift and should be checked before reading anything else
